description: What happened, from the row's kind, source and headline. A row can carry several. analysis and unclassified exist so that no label is forced.

values.label: Disclosure
values.definition: A weakness is disclosed: every advisory, bulletin and note by kind, or a headline naming a vulnerability.

values.label: Exploitation
values.definition: The row's exploitation tag is known or reported.

values.label: Patch
values.definition: A fix or update is released: every vendor-primary advisory, or a headline about a patch.

values.label: Breach
values.definition: A headline reports a compromise, intrusion or data theft at a named or unnamed organization.

values.label: Outage
values.definition: A headline reports a service outage or disruption.

values.label: Takedown
values.definition: A headline reports law enforcement action: arrests, charges, seizures or infrastructure takedowns.

values.label: Policy
values.definition: A headline reports law, regulation, sanctions, government strategy or official guidance.

values.label: Analysis
values.definition: A research row with none of the values above: analysis, tooling or a technical write-up.

values.label: Unclassified
values.definition: No rule applied. The row is not forced into a label.

values.label: Maintenance
values.definition: A vendor-scheduled maintenance window. Reserved for the maintenance calendar the revision plan adds; it carries no headline terms, so no headline sets it.

values.label: End of support
values.definition: A product, version or service reaches end of support, end of life or retirement. Reserved for the lifecycle and cloud-change sources the revision plan adds; it carries no headline terms, so no headline sets it.
